<!-- Main Content -->
<section class="main-content">
<div class="main-content__text-block">
<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-12">
<h2>Helping You Care For Your Orchids Since 1921</h2>
<h5>For over 80 years, the American Orchid Society has been dedicated to providing fellow orchid growers with the most comprehensive orchid information on the planet, and continues to be a leading supporter of orchid research and conservation worldwide.</h5>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-4 col-md-4">
<article class="content-article"><img alt="" class="content-article__image" src="//aos-static-files.americanorchidso.netdna-cdn.com/img/article-img1.png"/>
<h3>Popular Orchid Care Articles</h3>
<p>Wherever you are along your orchid-growing journey, youíre sure to find a few great orchid care articles on the AOS website.</p>
<p>Discover how to <a href="/orchids/orchid-care/orchids-101.aspx">grow orchids</a>, <a href="/orchids/orchid-care/how-do-i-water-my-orchid.aspx">water orchids properly</a><a href="/orchids/orchid-care/how-do-i-water-my-orchid.aspx"> </a>and <a href="/orchids/orchid-care/when-should-i-repot.aspx">how to repot orchids</a> without damaging the roots.</p>
<p>Learn all about <a href="/orchids/culture-sheets/phalaenopsis.aspx">phalaenopsis care</a> or <a href="/orchids/culture-sheets/novice-dendrobium.aspx">growing dendrobiums</a>, and numerous other popular orchid species and hybrids like cymbidiums, vanda orchids, paphiopedilums and on and on.<br/>
You will also find valuable articles covering both <a href="/orchids/orchid-pests-diseases.aspx">prevention and remedies for orchid pests and orchid diseases.</a></p>
<p>If you are an <a href="http://www.aos.org/about-us/aos-membership.aspx">American Orchid Society member</a>, you have considerably more resources at your disposal making growing orchids even more enjoyable and successful.</p>
<p> </p>
</article>
</div>
<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-4 col-md-4">
<article class="content-article"><img alt="" class="content-article__image" src="//aos-static-files.americanorchidso.netdna-cdn.com/img/article-img2.png"/>
<h3>The Award-Winning ORCHIDS Magazine</h3>
<p>All AOS members receive a complimentary subscription to ORCHIDS magazine. If you aren't already a member, you can still <a href="http://aosoffers.com/free-issue" target="_blank">download a free issue of ORCHIDS magazine right now.</a></p>
<p>Each issue of ORCHIDS magazine is packed with photos of award-winning orchids, interesting articles, how-to advice and so much more.</p>
<p>All AOS members also have access to the digital archive for instant viewing of all issues since January 2013. If you aren't an AOS member yet, <a href="http://www.aos.org/about-us/aos-membership.aspx">join today and get instant access to the digital archive.</a></p>
</article>
</div>
<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-4 col-md-4">
<article class="content-article"><img alt="" class="content-article__image" src="//aos-static-files.americanorchidso.netdna-cdn.com/img/article-img3.png"/>
<h3>FREE Webinars &amp; Greenhouse Chats</h3>
<p>Join the global community of orchid-growers on AOS’ one-of-a-kind webinars where the world’s top orchid experts share the latest in orchid research and valuable information on caring for your orchids.</p>
<p><a href="/orchids/webinars/public/introduction-to-orchids-and-their-culture.aspx">Introduction: Orchids and Their Culture</a> is one of the most watched webinars and the perfect place to start to learn the fundamentals of growing orchids</p>
<p>Could you benefit from expert guidance on caring for Phalaenopsis? <a href="/orchids/webinars/public/the-basics-of-growing-the-beautiful-moth-orchid.aspx">See the popular webinar: Growing Phalaenopsis</a></p>
<p>As an AOS member, you get exclusive access to popular members-only webinars including <a href="/orchids/webinars/member-only/orchids-pest-management.aspx">Orchids: Pests and Their Management, Orchid Nutrition</a>, and many more - all including Q&amp;A chats ready for you to watch right now.</p>
<p><a href="/orchids/webinars.aspx">Click here to access the full list of ready-to-watch webinars and be the first to know about upcoming LIVE webinars</a></p>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="main-content__about-block main-content__about-block--purple">
<div class="inner">
<div class="container">
<h2 class="main-content__support-block__title">Help Support Us</h2>
<p>Your support and contributions make possible educational opportunities, orchid conservation and research, and a word-class awards and judging system. For that, we  are incredibly thankful. We humbly ask for your support.</p>
<div class="aligncenter"><a class="cta-button cta-button--white" href="https://secure.aos.org/donate/default.aspx">donate now</a></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
